Anna (Security): @here Privacy Attestation bundle for Private (VPC + on-prem) is published and available now :tada:
Anna (Security): This is a customer-facing bundle (docs + artifacts) to help pilots and early enterprise customers validate our privacy & data-residency controls for Private deployments. No embargo, please share with CSMs/SEs.
Mike (Product): Nice — what's included in the bundle?
Anna (Security): Included: SOC2 addendum language (for customer contracts), ISO control mapping, a sample attestation letter, network/KMS checklists, and a short FAQ for sales objections. Also an internal CSM playbook with recommended talking points.
Priya (Solutions): Sending to active pilots this afternoon. Any special steps for Hosted->Private migrations we should warn customers about?
Anna (Security): Yes — see migration checklist. Key items: 1) KMS key import/rotation steps, 2) firewall rules and allowed outbound addresses, 3) prefix/KV cache warmup notes. We also added an example health check command: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://private.redwood.example/v1/health`
Carlos (Infra): For on-prem bundles we also included `generate_self_attest.sh` — run `./generate_self_attest.sh --org acme --region eu` to produce starter artifacts the customer can sign.
Priya (Solutions): Perfect. I'll include that script in the customer walkthrough and add a short video clip to the playbook.
Anna (Security): Quick note for SEs/sales: this is an attestation bundle, not a new SOC2 certificate. Language to use is in the FAQ (do NOT represent it as certification).
Mike (Product): Understood. We'll update the sales one-pager and PR the public docs. PR: #docs-merge-1723.
deploy-bot: docs-private-attestation v1.0 deployed to /internal/docs at 1834567940
Anna (Security): We'll host a 30-min walkthrough for CSMs/SEs tomorrow 11:00 PT — calendar invite sent. If you spot gaps in the artifacts, ping me directly.
Priya (Solutions): I'll collect feedback from pilots and drop a summary in #customer-success later today.
Anna (Security): Thanks everyone — appreciate quick turns on this.
